# PXI

> PXI is an event platform built around the memory of the night. Attendees discover events, buy tickets, shoot into one live shared camera roll, and wake up to a scrapbook that compiles itself the morning after, plus a digital passport of attendance stamps. Organizers get ticketing in their own brand (revenue paid straight to their own Stripe account), live door scanning with signed tickets, real-time sales and turnout analytics, a venue heat map, audience segments with email and SMS campaigns, and a marketing kit built from the night's top photos. Free to host; see pricing for paid-ticket fees. iPhone app plus a web dashboard.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://pxispace.com/): What PXI is: tickets, the live shared camera roll, and the morning-after scrapbook, for attendees and organizers.
- [Platform](https://pxispace.com/platform): The organizer product: branded event ticketing, door scanning, sales analytics, the room heat map, audience CRM and campaigns.
- [About](https://pxispace.com/about): Mission, vision and values. Memory is the product.
- [Pricing](https://pxispace.com/pricing): Free to host; paid-ticket fees; free events cost nothing.
- [Events](https://pxispace.com/events): Discover public events and open the app.

## Features
- [Shared event photo gallery](https://pxispace.com/features/shared-event-photo-gallery): One live camera roll per event; everyone shoots into a single album.
- [Digital event passport](https://pxispace.com/features/digital-event-passport): Attendance stamps and passport levels from Wanderer to Odyssey.
- [Branded event ticketing](https://pxispace.com/features/branded-event-ticketing): Your brand, your revenue, paid directly via Stripe.
- [Event analytics](https://pxispace.com/features/event-promoter-analytics): Sales pace, turnout, hype through the night and the venue heat map.
- [Instagram event sharing](https://pxispace.com/features/instagram-event-sharing): One-tap framed post cards from your scrapbook.
